description:
You are the DevOps lead at Meridian Payments, a fintech startup migrating to a microservices architecture. The platform architecture committee has defined the following mandatory artifact management requirements for the Artifactory instance:

- A local Maven repository named 'ms-releases' must exist with the description 'Microservice release artifacts - Meridian Payments'. This is the authoritative store for all internal microservice release JARs.
- A remote Maven repository named 'maven-central-proxy' must proxy Maven Central at https://repo1.maven.org/maven2, so build pipelines can cache and resolve public dependencies.
- A virtual Maven repository named 'ms-build-virtual' must aggregate both sources. Internal releases must take precedence — 'ms-releases' must appear before 'maven-central-proxy' in the repository order.
- A group named 'build-engineers' must exist for the CI/CD platform team.
- A permission target named 'build-access' must grant the 'build-engineers' group both Deploy and Read privileges on the 'ms-releases' repository.

All five requirements must be fully configured before the build pipelines can be enabled. The Artifactory admin panel is at http://localhost:8082 (credentials: admin / password).
